Akali Dal backs delimitation and women's reservation bills, fueling alliance speculation

Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) leader Sukhbir Singh Badal met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, after which the party announced its support for the delimitation bill and the women's reservation law. SAD leader Gulzar Singh stated these bills are in Punjab's interest for peace and prosperity, and the party reached an agreement with the central government on them. The development has intensified political activity in Punjab and fueled speculation about a potential alliance between the SAD and the BJP.
